name: BEA Data API
rate_limits: 100 requests a minute, 100 MB a minute and 30 errors a minute; going over blocks you for about a minute (source: BEA API user guide PDF).
what_it_has: US GDP, PCE inflation, personal income, and international trade and investment figures.
simple: The US government office that adds up how big the economy is and how much people spend.
license_terms: Free key after giving a name and email and agreeing to the terms of service. US government data, generally public domain. https://apps.bea.gov/api/signup/
quality_notes: GDP is revised several times after the first estimate and the API gives the latest values only. Use ALFRED if first estimates matter.

relevance.reason: Mostly duplicated on FRED, and quarterly data is slow for FX signals.
